lines.text: Everyone wants to be in the top one percent.
But nobody wants to hear how you actually get there.
Rome wasn't built in a day.
It was built brick, by brick. One stone, every single day.
Get one percent better today, and you won't even notice.
But one percent better, every day, for a year, makes you thirty seven times better.
One percent worse every day, and you fall to almost nothing.
Greatness isn't one giant leap. It's a staircase.
Most people quit on the first few steps, because they can't see the top.
The one percent? They just keep climbing.
Welcome to the one percent club.
